svg.text: Mattress up to 1,600 x 2,000 (local size, e.g. 5 x 6 ft), 200 mm
GALLEY looking at the bathroom wall
Inset stainless sink about 380 x 420, single bowl
Slim recirculating hood 600 mm, black, charcoal filter
END B (bathroom) looking at x = L
Cement board 12 mm + liquid membrane, splashback behind the basin (end wall B, wash lobby)
Slim concealed cistern frame (80 mm) with dual-flush plate, in the end-B stud wall and its 30 mm build-out
Cement board 12 mm + liquid membrane, end wall B, built out 30 mm over the concealed WC cistern (stud wall inside the cargo doors)
Wall basin 400 x 300 + mixer + bottle trap (wash lobby)
30 L heater box on end wall B above the WC
Wall-hung WC, short projection (520), soft-close seat
Clear height about 2,323 mm after a 60 mm ceiling and a 10 mm floor build-up (AS-15).
The 2012 rules asked 2.4 m over half a habitable room (STU-11, superseded); the founder reports approval.
Wall fans, not ceiling fans (blades would be below 2.1 m). Split-AC provision: sleeve + 16 A circuit.
